# Deployment & Container Build Requirements Quality Checklist: Rely on Jib Container Images in Docker Compose

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, clarity, and consistency for containerization, Docker Compose migration, and deployment requirements.  
**Created**: 2026-09-18  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Container Image Build & Reactor Requirements (Jib)

- [x] CHK001 Are image naming conventions and repository namespaces explicitly specified for all 8 microservices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK002 Is the dual-tagging mechanism (`${project.version}` and `latest`) specified with unambiguous tag resolution rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-18]
- [x] CHK003 Are skip requirements explicitly defined for non-runnable modules (`common/event-contracts` and root POM)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK004 Is the Java 26 ASM bytecode compatibility workaround (explicit `mainClass` declaration) documented for all application entrypoints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Research §Decision 2]
- [x] CHK005 Are the exact fully-qualified class names for all 8 Spring Boot main classes specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the base container image (`eclipse-temurin:26-jre-alpine`) specified consistently across the reactor? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Decision 1]
- [x] CHK007 Can the reactor build command (`./mvnw compile jib:dockerBuild -DskipTests`) be objectively verified for all modules? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]

## 2. Docker Compose & Runtime Parity Requirements

- [x] CHK008 Are all 8 application microservices in `docker-compose.apps.yml` mapped to Jib images without missing services? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK009 Is fallback tag resolution behavior specified when `IMAGE_TAG` is unset in the environment (`${IMAGE_TAG:-latest}`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-18]
- [x] CHK010 Are runtime resource boundaries (`mem_limit: 512m`) preserved consistently across all service definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK011 Are JVM heap configurations (`JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Xms128m -Xmx384m`) verified to be consistent with container memory limits? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Are container port allocations (8080 for Gateway, 8082-8088 for domain services) preserved without port conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK013 Are service dependency graphs and health check conditions (`depends_on: postgres/kafka/redis: condition: service_healthy`) preserved from legacy configurations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are active profile requirements (`SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker`) maintained across all service definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]

## 3. Legacy Artifact Removal & Cleanliness

- [x] CHK015 Is the removal of `docker/Dockerfile.service` explicitly specified with zero remaining references in Compose? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-18]
- [x] CHK016 Does the spec clarify whether the parent `docker/` directory should be removed if empty after deleting `Dockerfile.service`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements clear regarding elimination of `build:` blocks and `JAR_FILE` build arguments across all services? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-009]

## 4. Edge Cases & Failure Recovery Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Is the error behavior specified when a developer executes `docker compose up` before running `jib:dockerBuild`? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements specified for partial build failures where some service images build while others fail? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is behavior defined when building images in environments with daemon authentication challenges? [Edge Cases, Research §Decision 1]
- [x] CHK021 Are multi-architecture build constraints (e.g., ARM64 Apple Silicon vs x86_64 CI runner) documented in assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
